inputs.prompt: Restyle this exact image as traditional hand-drawn Japanese 2D gothic anime. Preserve the source composition, camera angle, character identities, anatomy, pose, gaze, number of people, costume colors, ornament sides, props and architecture. Only simplify the rendering: confident continuous dark ink outlines, broad connected hair locks, flat matte skin, hard-edged two-tone cel shadows, painted background shapes and hand-drawn line patterns. No glossy 3D skin, plastic dolls, realistic individual hair strands, photoreal lace texture, PBR metal, mirror floor reflections, depth-of-field blur or CGI. Preserve the existing cool blue window light and restrained amber practical light; do not introduce new lamps or fire. No words or captions. Retain the exact low-angle close three-quarter view of the red-haired male priest facing image right. Same swept short red-brown hair, sharp calm face, black high-collared gold-embroidered robe, and the hand holding the same torch at image right. Torch flame must keep a BLACK CORE with narrow VIOLET edges, never orange, cyan or opaque smoke. Convert gold embroidery to simple drawn lines, not shiny 3D jewelry. Keep one torch and same hand.
inputs.negative_prompt: 3d, cgi, photorealism, glossy plastic skin, realistic hair strands, volumetric rendering, text, watermark
